_help: Statewide organizations listed by hand at their request, shown in the 'Benefits & support' group of the sidebar. They are not Medicaid IDD service providers and are not on the state lists the map uses; the weekly data refresh never changes this file. "kind" picks the row: "benefits" (Help with benefits: SSI, SSDI, Medicaid applications) or "funding" (Funding for care & daily life). Add an office address later to place one on the map. Phone numbers are not shown on the site.

organizations.name: Shields Consulting
services: Appeals: reconsideration, hearings with a judge, Appeals Council and federal court
Social Security overpayment notices: waivers and repayment plans
organizations.serves: All of New York, with online consultations
organizations.about: Social Security disability representation. Describes itself as a Social Security Administration Designated Service Group, with over 20 years of experience. Free consultations.
organizations.connected: Its founder also started The Rose Foundation NY, which it helps fund.

organizations.name: The Rose Foundation NY
services: Caregiving assistance: help paying for care hours, respite and emergency gaps in care
Travel assistance: rides to medical and therapy appointments, accessible transit
Independent living: adaptive equipment, home modifications, life skills support
organizations.serves: All of New York State; apply online
organizations.about: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families, closing gaps that other funding leaves.
organizations.connected: Founded by Ashley Shields of Shields Consulting NY, which gives 10% of its proceeds to the foundation.
